intro_1.text: 1994. A slim penguin washes ashore in Silicon Valley. He has one goal: get out.

intro_2.speaker: PINGU
intro_2.text: Let me get this straight. The ocean had everything, and humanity chose... venture capital.

intro_3.speaker: NARRATOR
intro_3.text: Legend says a black airplane waits in Oakland. Two blue lines on its hull. The only honest thing left: trust.

controls_card.speaker: HOW TO PENGUIN
controls_card.text: MOVE: WASD/ARROWS   RUN: HOLD MOVE   J: WING ATTACK   L: THROW DISK   K: SPECIAL   SPACE: DODGE   E: INTERACT   I: BAG   C: STATS   ESC: PAUSE

area1_intro.speaker: SIGN
area1_intro.text: Welcome to Silicon Valley. Your dream has a 98% failure rate.

area1_tip.speaker: PINGU
area1_tip.text: Move with WASD or the arrows. J to whack something. SPACE to tumble out of trouble.

area2_intro.speaker: SIGN
area2_intro.text: We are not bankrupt. We are pre-revenue.

area2_tip.speaker: PINGU
area2_tip.text: K is for special abilities. They cost energy. L throws whatever is in your paw.

area3_intro.speaker: SIGN
area3_intro.text: Your code is not free until you understand the license.

area3_tip.speaker: PINGU
area3_tip.text: The terminals here still work. Save often. Trust nothing with a Terms of Service.

area4_intro.speaker: SIGN
area4_intro.text: Congratulations! Your company is now worth zero dollars, but your valuation is up 300%.

area4_tip.speaker: PINGU
area4_tip.text: Elite corporate guards. My favorite kind of problem: expensive and wrong.

area5_intro.speaker: SIGN
area5_intro.text: FINAL BOARDING CALL. ALL EXIT STRATEGIES REQUIRE BOARD APPROVAL.

area5_warn.speaker: PINGU
area5_warn.text: That's the gate. Whatever's behind it has a corner office. I hate corner offices.

cto_intro.speaker: CTO
cto_intro.text: YOU CANNOT LEAVE! YOUR EXIT STRATEGY HAS NOT BEEN APPROVED BY THE BOARD!

cto_p1.speaker: CTO
cto_p1.text: Behold: SYNERGY. Phase one of a seventeen-phase roadmap.

cto_p2.speaker: CTO
cto_p2.text: Let me run it through my AI... it hallucinated a competitor. FICTIONAL. But aggressive.

cto_p3.speaker: CTO
cto_p3.text: ACTIVATING PREMIUM MODE. Every action now requires a subscription!

cto_die.speaker: CTO
cto_die.text: No... you cannot just... LEAVE... that's a violation of section 14.2(b)...

bsdemon_1.speaker: BSDemon
bsdemon_1.text: Have you tried compiling it yourself?

bsdemon_2.speaker: BSDemon
bsdemon_2.text: YOUR LAYOUT IS NOT THE CORRECT LAYOUT!

bill_1.speaker: Little Bill
bill_1.text: Your freedom is currently available as a premium feature.

bill_2.speaker: Little Bill
bill_2.text: I'm not buying you. I'm ACQUIRING your potential.

hipster_1.speaker: GPL Hipster
hipster_1.text: Actually, I wrote something similar in 1998.

hipster_2.speaker: GPL Hipster
hipster_2.text: That's a fork of a fork of a fork of MY code.

bot_1.speaker: Security Bot
bot_1.text: THIS CARD IS NOT A VALID BADGE OF HONOR.

plane_1.speaker: PINGU
plane_1.text: Two blue lines. Trust, version controlled. I like it.

plane_2.speaker: NARRATOR
plane_2.text: Destination: Oaxaca City. Altitude: finally above it all.

plane_3.text: Trust is not a feature. It is the flight plan.

gameover_1.speaker: NARRATOR
gameover_1.text: PINGU has stopped responding. (It was never a kernel problem.)

gameover_2.speaker: PINGU
gameover_2.text: I'll be back. I always reboots.

miggy_intro.speaker: MIGGY
miggy_intro.text: So this is the legacy codebase. I brought a compiler and zero patience.

miggy_area2.speaker: MIGGY
miggy_area2.text: Pre-revenue? I've seen worse. I've compiled worse.

miggy_area3.speaker: MIGGY
miggy_area3.text: Finally, a place where the license is the weapon.

miggy_area4.speaker: MIGGY
miggy_area4.text: Unicorns. Cute. I prefer a shell prompt.

miggy_area5.speaker: MIGGY
miggy_area5.text: Board approval? I am the board now.

miggy_idle_3.speaker: MIGGY
miggy_idle_3.text: There is no problem a new abstraction layer can't postpone.

miggy_idle_4.speaker: MIGGY
miggy_idle_4.text: The command line is a perfectly reasonable UI. For everything.

cp_save.speaker: TERMINAL
cp_save.text: Checkpoint saved. Your secrets are stored in /tmp. You're welcome.

cp_full.speaker: TERMINAL
cp_full.text: HP and energy restored. The terminal charged you 0 coins and 0 dignity.

joke_1.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_1.text: Employee of the month: a vending machine. Nobody challenged it.

joke_2.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_2.text: This office is 'mission-driven'. The mission is rent.

joke_3.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_3.text: Free hugs. Also free NDAs. Choose carefully.

joke_4.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_4.text: WiFi: guest_5G. Password: in a PDF that needs another PDF.

joke_5.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_5.text: The coffee machine has a roadmap. It is v0.3 'liquid, maybe'.

joke_6.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_6.text: Sandbox: where your code pretends to be production.

joke_7.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_7.text: We don't fire people. We give them a 'growth opportunity' downtown.

joke_8.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_8.text: Trust levels painted on the wall. Last updated: before the IPO.

joke_9.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_9.text: There is a 404 behind this wall. Please knock.

joke_10.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_10.text: Open source, closed minds. Thanks for migrating.

joke_11.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_11.text: The servers are warm. Like the community. Like a burning building.

joke_12.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_12.text: Sharks hired here. Legal reclassified them as 'independent contractors'.

joke_13.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_13.text: Please exit through the gift shop. The gift is leaving with no equity.

joke_14.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_14.text: Baggage claim: where promises go to be delayed 4-6 business quarters.

joke_15.speaker: PLAQUE
joke_15.text: Boarding requires: ticket, ID, and a signed waiver of curiosity.

ev_pitch.speaker: FOUNDER
ev_pitch.text: It's like a penguin, but for your router. We raised $40M. Want in?

ev_pitch_win.speaker: PINGU
ev_pitch_win.text: Brilliant. Terrible. Here's a coin for your trouble.

ev_atm.speaker: CRYPTO ATM
ev_atm.text: YOUR $PINGU COIN IS WORTH LESS THAN THIS BOOTH.

ev_vend.speaker: VENDING
ev_vend.text: This machine accepts equity instead of coins. It gives you snacks.

ev_hack.speaker: PINGU
ev_hack.text: A free public terminal. Risky. Worth it. I feel alive and litigious.

ev_intern.speaker: INTERN
ev_intern.text: I worked here for 8 months. They gave me a t-shirt and existential dread.

ev_elevator.speaker: ELEVATOR
ev_elevator.text: Going up? Too late. You went down three floors of scope.

ev_meme.speaker: MEME SHRINE
ev_meme.text: A tribute to a campaign that trended for 15 minutes. It heals something in you.

ev_drone.speaker: DELIVERY DRONE
ev_drone.text: YOUR PACKAGE HAS ARRIVED AT THE WRONG ADDRESS. IT IS A WEAPON.

ev_shark.speaker: SHARK
ev_shark.text: I invest in failures. Specifically yours. Here's $20. Say 'synergy'.
